Technical Evaluation Scoring Guide (0-100):
0-20: Poor - Goals significantly missed, quality issues, low productivity 21-40: Fair - Some goals met, inconsistent quality, average productivity 41-60: Good - Most goals on track, acceptable quality, meets expectations 61-80: Very Good - Goals exceeding expectations, high quality, strong productivity 81-100: Excellent - All goals exceeded, exceptional quality, outstanding innovation

Behavioral Evaluation Scoring (1-5):
1 = Poor: Consistently demonstrates weakness in this area 2 = Fair: Demonstrates this competency inconsistently 3 = Good: Demonstrates this competency adequately 4 = Very Good: Consistently demonstrates this competency at a high level 5 = Excellent: Exemplary demonstration of this competency
Evaluated Areas: - Teamwork: Collaboration, cooperation with colleagues - Communication: Clarity, listening, information sharing - Leadership: Guidance, motivation, decision-making - Integrity: Honesty, ethics, accountability - Initiative: Proactivity, self-motivation, continuous improvement - Problem Solving: Analysis, creative solutions, practical approach

Final Performance Score to Rating Conversion:
81-100: Excellent - Far exceeds requirements 61-80: Very Good - Exceeds requirements 41-60: Good - Meets requirements 21-40: Fair - Partially meets requirements 1-20: Poor - Does not meet requirements
PIP Trigger: Scores below 60% automatically trigger Performance Improvement Plan
